artifact_root.description: Existing canonical absolute task-local artifact directory

max_trajectory_bytes.description: Full-core trajectory is disk-backed with no total byte cap by default; an explicit integer preserves its finite execution budget.

model_acceleration.description: Legacy false is treated as omitted; Fast is retired. Do not request true.

operations.description: Declare exact operation kinds, not write. The workspace compiler decides which kinds and scopes are admitted; this vocabulary grants nothing.

allowed_operations.description: Additional requested operations for DCF compilation, not an override of workspace policy. Local preparation uses operations.

source_read.description: True requires read and command operations and selects exact regular-file reads without symlink ancestry. Directory discovery uses read_directories instead; local preparation accepts matching directory/** scopes alongside exact files. False is normalized to omission without adding a read grant.

read_directories.description: Exact existing non-hidden workspace-relative directories, not '.', '**' or symlinks. Requires read and command operations. DCF also requires matching directory/** read_scopes; local mode accepts the same shape without treating directory scopes as files.

command_templates.description: Prefer typed declarations; legacy exact scoped cat/pwd strings are normalized automatically. Other strings require a capability-specific action. The workspace compiler checks support, effects, operands and scopes.
